thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. We promised a concise set of dates and who owns them for API, Console, and Optimize. Please answer with confirmations or short blockers.
rebecca: Product recap: API (hosted) GA public target 2026-10-10, internal GA 2026-09-25. Console revamp public GA 2026-11-20. Optimize early access beta 2026-07-12. Owners: rebecca (API), samir (Console DX), diego (Optimize infra).
diego: Optimize depends on batching refactor + perf infra. Batching refactor rolling to canary 2026-06-26; perf sweep scheduled 2026-07-02. If sweep passes, beta opens as planned.
samir: DevRel/DevEx will deliver: 1) Console admin quickstart 2) migration checklist 3) two reference apps. Target initial PRs 2026-07-18. Need runtime review for samples.
anya: Leadership note: API streaming + function calling are top priority for the hosted GA. Console's full visual polish is not required for GA; scope should focus on admin flows and rollout APIs.
mike: Sales ask: one-page "customer-facing bullets" needed by 2026-07-22 so reps can align messaging. Also request a short FAQ about Dedicated compatibility.
rebecca: Scope confirmation: API GA = streaming, function/tool calls, quotas/rate-limits, basic analytics export. Console GA = route/model dashboards, rollout/canary UI, admin permissions. Optimize beta = batching recommendations, quantization guidance, perf baseline reports.
diego: For Dedicated customers we plan a pilot in August with 3 tenants to validate autoscale changes. I'll post pilot invites by 2026-07-05.
samir: We'll freeze docs two weeks before each public GA. Also scheduling a docs review with product on 2026-09-15 for API materials.
allhands-bot: Created checklist #9201 "AH: roadmap dates & owner confirmations" assigned to alex, rebecca, diego, samir, mike. Due 2026-06-30.
alex: Please mark any objections on checklist #9201 by EOD Monday. If engineering flags a blocker after the perf sweep, we will call an immediate sync.
diego: Understood. I'll post the perf sweep results here on 2026-07-02. If regressions appear, i'll open a blocker ticket and ping leadership.
mike: Sales will prepare the one-pager draft and post to this thread by 2026-07-20 for review.
rebecca: Thanks — will update the public roadmap once engineering confirms the canary results. Short sync scheduled Thursday 11am PT to finalize any last scope cuts. :calendar:
